senses.gloss: same; 2) (denom. of נֵס) to put up a sign; to ask for a test (cmp.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55:6">Gen. R. s. 55</cite>, beg. (interpret. <cite ref="N00914"><he>נִסָּה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 22:1">Gen. XXII, 1</cite>) <he>בשביל לנַסּוֹתָן … לגדלן וכ׳</he> in order to lift them up (as a standard) for the world, to raise them &c., v. <cite ref="N00913"><he>נֵס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Genesis 22:1">Ib.</cite> (ref. to Gen. l. c.) R. J. says <he>גדלו כנס וכ׳</he> he raised him &c.; R. A. says, <he>נ׳ אותן בוודאי</he> he really tried him, v. <cite ref="F00014"><he>וַדַּאי</he></cite>. Ib. <he>אין הקב״ה מְנַסֶּה וכ׳</he> the Lord does not test the wicked, but only the righteous; ib. s. 32; s. 34. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 1 (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 15:25">Ex. XV, 25</cite>) <he>גדולה</he>(<cite ref="L00000"><he>ל</he></cite>) <he>שם נשא לו</he> there he raised him (Moses) to greatness; … <he>שם נסה המקום את ישראל</he> there God tested Israel.
<cite ref="Exodus 15:25">Ib.</cite> Yithro, Baḥod., s. 9 <he>לבעבור נַסּוֹת אתכם בשביל לגדל אתכם</he> (<cite ref="Exodus 20:28">Ex. XX, 28</cite>) ‘to lift you up’, to raise you.
<cite ref="Arakhin 15a:38">Arakh. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>עשר נסיונות נִיסּוּ וכ׳</he> ten times did our ancestors try the Lord; <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:4">Ab. V, 4</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 777:6">Yalk. Ps. 777</cite> <he>הראשונים מִתְנַסִּים ביד הקב״ה … אבל האחרונים נִתְנַסּוּ וכ׳</he> the ancients were tried by the Lord …, but the latter generations were tried by the nations; a. fr.
